job.title: Senior Software Engineer - SAP Commerce Cloud

tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java & Spring | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, OCC APIs, Solr, Impex, Backoffice and database performance tuning. Proven delivery of PIM and ERP data integrations, cloud deployments on CCv2, and agile delivery. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer - SAP Commerce Cloud
cover_en.hook: Bringing over five years of dedicated engineering experience designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise digital commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud, I am eager to contribute to Henry Schein. In my recent roles at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have built robust and scalable eCommerce features using SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and Spring.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Architecture & Extensions
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: OCC APIs & Headless Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and customized Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for seamless data flows across storefront and third-party consumers.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integrations & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub, resolving integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Platform Performance & Quality Assurance
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency, built automated unit test suites with JUnit, executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, and conducted code reviews in agile environments.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am currently serving a notice period through 15 December 2026, with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my SAP Commerce expertise aligns with your technical roadmap.

tailoring.why_company: Henry Schein's commitment to advancing digital commerce platforms in the healthcare sector presents an exciting opportunity to apply my deep SAP Commerce Cloud and Java expertise. I am eager to bring my hands-on background from Rockwell Automation and Shell in building scalable catalog, pricing, and order management features to support your high-availability enterprise environment.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience across Rockwell Automation and Shell, I design robust Java extensions, OCC APIs, and enterprise integrations.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) development experience across Rockwell Automation and Shell, I build scalable Java extensions, OCC APIs, and ERP integrations. I am exploring new opportunities and would love to connect about your Senior SAP Commerce role.
tailoring.email_subject: Application - Senior Software Engineer - SAP Commerce Cloud - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Software Engineer - SAP Commerce Cloud position at Henry Schein. With over five years of hands-on experience building, extending, and supporting enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring, OCC APIs, Solr, and PIM/ERP integrations.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
